```{r B cell senescence}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)

#read the rds
data <- readRDS("/path_to_folder/All_merged_after_integration_annotated.rds")

#subset the spatial seurat object to only identify the B cell population

bcell_obj <- subset(data, idents = "B cells")

```

## B cell senescence score

```{r BSM}
#get the B cell associated senescence geneset from scRNA seq analyses as identified in Figure 4B

sen_gene <- read.csv("/path_to_folder/Sig_Bcell_ senescence_genes.csv") 
# this geneset has all the genes included after the gsea analyses and were linked to B cell senescence

sc_sig <- sen_gene$Genes

#score the signature in Visium

bcell_obj <- AddModuleScore(bcell_obj, features = list(sc_sig), name = "Sen_signature")

#get a mean and median score for the senescnece signature across all the samples
df <- as.data.frame(
  bcell_obj@meta.data[, c("sample", "Sen_signature1")]
)

sample_summary <- df %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_score = mean(Sen_signature1, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_score = median(Sen_signature1, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

sample_summary

write.csv(sample_summary, "/path_to_folder/Sen_Score_Bcell.csv")

```

#Enbed spatial plots

```{r plots, echo=TRUE}

#lets plot the unique plots for with senescnece score

#Plot the spatial plots
all_scores <- bcell_obj$Sen_signature1

# 5th and 95th percentile for contrast
min_cut <- quantile(all_scores, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
max_cut <- quantile(all_scores, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)

# Optional: define threshold to gray out low spots (e.g., bottom 50%)
threshold <- quantile(all_scores, 0.5, na.rm = TRUE)

# ----------------------------
# Step 2: Create highlight column
# ----------------------------
bcell_obj$Sen_highlight <- ifelse(
  bcell_obj$Sen_signature1 >= threshold,
  bcell_obj$Sen_signature1,
  NA
)

# ----------------------------
# Step 3: Loop over samples and generate plots
# ----------------------------
plots <- lapply(unique(bcell_obj$sample), function(s) {
  
  bcell_sample <- subset(bcell_obj, subset = sample == s)
  
  SpatialFeaturePlot(
    bcell_sample,
    features = "Sen_highlight",
    min.cutoff = min_cut,
    max.cutoff = max_cut
  ) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colours = c("yellow", "orange", "red"),
      na.value = "grey80") +
    ggtitle(s) + 
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.direction = "vertical",
      text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman", size = 16, face = "bold")
    )
})

names(plots) <- unique(bcell_obj$sample)

plots

#save all the plots
for (s in names(plots)) {
  
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0("/path_to_folder/Figure 5D-E/Senescence_Bcell_", s, ".png"),
    plot = plots[[s]],
    width = 6,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 600
  )
}


```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
